Biosol Microbalding in Somerville

Why choose microblanding
There are many benefits to microblading, here are the most important ones:

Each stroke is manually drawn-in
The use of very thin blades
Obtaining a natural looking eyebrow
Longer lasting results
Faster treatment

HOW IS THE PROCEDURE APPLIED
The microblading artist will apply the pigment manually into the surface of one of the upper layers of the skin. The pigment is chosen according to the natural color of the client’s eyebrows and hair. The artist can also blend different shades if it is required to obtain the required color. The pigment will at first appear much darker, but can fade up to 30% within a month after the treatment. The tools used are sterile, disposable and new for each client. Corrections or touch ups are usually recommended to be done a month after the initial treatment, as some strokes may get lost during the skin healing time. It is also recommended that client uses an aftercare creams to avoid healing problems.

STEPS

 

First -  Avaliation

Second -  Shape

Third  -  Color

Forth -  Nubing

Fifth - Microblading

 

 

 

VALUES

Eyelash Extensions
Powerful look with voluminous, elongated and curved hair is the desire of many women. It is possible to obtain or search with several layers of mask or opt for an eyelash extension procedure
How long does eyelash extension last?
The average length of the eyelash extension lasts for a period of 30 days, and after that time if the stretch is already flawed and many strands are already down, you can redo the stretch.

Biosol Nails in Somerville

Nails
Experience the luxury and beauty of professional manicure and pedicure.
1. Nails 
A gel nail polish manicure is a service that uses a gel-based polish and requires a UV or LED light to cure the polish and lock it onto your nails. “Gel polish is more durable than regular polish,”. And while regular polish can chip as quick as two to three days, gel stays chip-free for weeks.

Diamond Peel

Diamond peel is a non-invasive, mechanical procedure that removes dead skin cells, dirt and excess oil on the skin surface. It improves the appearance of your skin, by revealing younger and radiant skin underneath in an instant

Skin Cleansing

A common benefit of facial cleansing is the removal of dirt, oil, and other unwanted debris. Throughout the day the skin on your face is continually covered with bacteria, pollutants, viruses, dirt, and old (dead) skin cells. Daily facial washing removes these impurities to give the skin a fresh look.

Chemical Peel

 

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_image src="http://biosolbeautysalon.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/peeling_chemical-biosol.jpg" _builder_version="4.16" custom_margin="-30px|||||" border_radii="on|15px|15px|15px|15px" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.16" global_colors_info="{}"]

A chemical peel is a skin-resurfacing procedure in which a chemical solution is applied to the skin to remove the top layers. The skin that grows back after a chemical peel is smoother and younger looking.

Dermaplaning

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_image src="http://biosolbeautysalon.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/dermaplaningbiosol.jpg" _builder_version="4.16" border_radii="on|16px|16px|16px|16px" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.16" global_colors_info="{}"]

Dermaplaning provides an effective and safe exfoliation treatment that promotes deeper product penetration, boosting the effects of skin care products while making the skin look and feel smoother and also reducing the appearance of acne scars. The treatment also works to remove facial hair that can trap dirt and oils.

Decrease wrinkles;
Improve the quality of collagen and elastin;
Improve skin hydration;
Reduce cellulite;
Fight stretch marks and fibrosis;

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value:
Aesthetic
Diamond Peel
Diamond peel is a non-invasive, mechanical procedure that removes dead skin cells, dirt and excess oil on the skin surface. It improves the appearance of your skin, by revealing younger and radiant skin underneath in an instant

Skin Cleansing
A common benefit of facial cleansing is the removal of dirt, oil, and other unwanted debris. Throughout the day the skin on your face is continually covered with bacteria, pollutants, viruses, dirt, and old (dead) skin cells. Daily facial washing removes these impurities to give the skin a fresh look.

Services
What Us Offer
Chemical Peel
 
A chemical peel is a skin-resurfacing procedure in which a chemical solution is applied to the skin to remove the top layers. The skin that grows back after a chemical peel is smoother and younger looking.
Dermaplaning
Dermaplaning provides an effective and safe exfoliation treatment that promotes deeper product penetration, boosting the effects of skin care products while making the skin look and feel smoother and also reducing the appearance of acne scars. The treatment also works to remove facial hair that can trap dirt and oils.
Radio Frequency
The radiofrequency technique can be indicated by your doctor, physiotherapist or beautician to treat various areas of the body and the professional can tell you what your case is. Radio frequency can be used to:
Decrease wrinkles;Improve the quality of collagen and elastin;Improve skin hydration;Reduce cellulite;Fight stretch marks and fibrosis;
